name: Boltglide
description: Keeps a pace of open ground to either side while advancing so that one blast of fire cannot take two riflemen.

name: Sightflog
description: Steps behind a trunk and leans one shoulder out to fire, using the bark to steady the forestock.

name: Keen Reticle
description: Fires from standing and drops at once to one knee so that the answering shot finds only empty air.

name: Slinking Chamber
description: Wriggles through scrub on the belly, parting stems with the barrel rather than the hands, to reach a new firing spot unseen.

name: Hungry Longshot
description: Pairs with a comrade so one loads while the other keeps a loaded rifle on the enemy, never leaving both barrels empty together.

name: Zeroscorer
description: Quickens the loading arm with qi to fire, load and fire again into one strip of ground until the enemy cannot cross it.

name: Scopestalk
description: Drives qi through the legs for a flat sprint between two points of cover with the rifle held tight across the chest.

name: Rude Magazine
description: Pours the charge with a breath of qi in the pouring hand so every measure falls to the same weight.

name: Breathslap
description: Counts three firm taps of the ramrod on the seated ball so that powder lies packed without crushing the grains.

name: Bold Rifling
description: Pinches tallow onto the cloth patch with finger and thumb so that the ball slides down the grooves without sticking.

name: Brisk Cheekrest
description: Flicks the pan cover shut with the thumb after priming so that jolts of the march do not spill the powder.

name: Zerothwack
description: Holds the hammer's fall at the very edge of the pan until breath, qi and sight agree, then lets it drop.

name: Prowling Buttpad
description: Carries the primed rifle low against the hip on the move so that it can be brought up in one pull.

name: Savage Squeeze
description: Seats the ball with a pulse of qi into the powder charge so the shot bites through a leather coat or thin plate.

name: Attentive Rearsight
description: Passes qi from lock to pan to barrel mouth to feel any crack, damp or blockage before the trigger is pressed.

name: Sightcurl
description: Slides the bayonet onto the muzzle and turns it home with a quarter twist while the enemy is still closing.

name: Fierce Muzzlebrake
description: Slides the leading hand back to the lock and stabs with the point from close in, tight to the body.

name: Armored Bolt
description: Beats a lunging blade aside with the bayonet's edge and returns the point to the enemy's face in the same motion.

name: Scopescreen
description: Plants the butt in the ground and angles the bayonet upward so a charging enemy runs onto the point.

name: Wild Longshot
description: Drives qi into the forward lunge so the bayonet punches through a shield rim or a buckled coat.

name: Clutching Scopemount
description: Traps an enemy's spear shaft against the barrel with a twist of the bayonet, then smashes his gripping hand with the butt.

name: Draught Chamber
description: Slides over a low rail with one hand on the top bar and the rifle held clear of the wood.

name: Brass Zero
description: Lays the forestock on the lip of a ditch and fires with the whole body hidden below the line of the ground.

name: Gleam Sight
description: Rises between two broken stones just long enough to fire and sinks again before the reply arrives.

name: Stout Rearsight
description: Stands with the shoulder to the doorframe and the barrel past its edge, so only the muzzle meets the street.

name: Gritbolt
description: Plants one hand on a fallen log and vaults it in a single stride, the rifle gripped at the balance.

name: Dire Reticle
description: Lies along a roof ridge with the barrel resting on a tile edge to shoot down at a street below.

name: Clay Magazine
description: Pours qi into arms and shoulders to hold the rifle firm on cover while splinters and glancing shot rattle past.

name: Breathhurdle
description: Advances in alternating dashes with a partner, each shooter covering the other's run with a ready rifle and qi-quickened legs.

name: Doughty Rifling
description: Places shot after shot at the top edge of the enemy's cover so he dares not raise his head to aim.

name: Comet Reticle
description: Fixes the eye on one point of the far target and holds the sight there through three slow breaths before firing.

name: Hum Chamber
description: Raises the point of aim above the mark by the amount the ball will fall over the judged distance.

name: Candor Rearsight
description: Climbs the rear leaf one notch at a time, matching each notch to a distance learned on the practice butts.

name: Lunar Magazine
description: Walks past a line of posts of known spacing and learns to read distance by how small the last one looks.

name: Recall Bolt
description: Watches where the first ball throws up earth and moves the aim by the same gap for the second.

name: Shardzero
description: Presses the forestock into a packed knapsack and the cheek into the stock until nothing moves but the heartbeat.

name: Stern Cheekrest
description: Sets the cheekbone against the same spot on the stock each time so the eye meets the sights unchanged.

name: Gap Bipod
description: Narrows the qi sense to a single far mark so the aim locks as though the target stood nearer.

name: Honed Longshot
description: Presses qi into the ball at the instant of firing so it keeps its bite to the end of the rifle's reach.

name: Mirage Buttpad
description: Fires, then slips behind brush while qi damps the footfalls so the enemy searches the wrong ground.

name: Boltthwack
description: Lays the barrel along the top rail of a fence and sinks the elbows onto the wood to kill all tremor.

name: Sleet Breath
description: Pokes the muzzle through a gap between stones so the wall hides everything but a hand's width of barrel.

name: Raw Sight
description: Fires from deep within a room across a sill, staying back in the shadow where the enemy cannot see the shooter.

name: Dense Muzzlebrake
description: Presses the chest against a stacked sandbag and tucks the stock into it so shot spends itself in the sand.

name: Veering Buttpad
description: Spins on the ball of the foot behind a corner after firing, bringing the rifle round with the hips.

name: Weighty Rifling
description: Feeds shot steadily through a single gap in a wall so the enemy cannot cross the opposite ground.

name: Cinderscope
description: Slips backward over loose stone on qi-light feet, keeping the muzzle trained until the next wall is reached.

name: Hum Rifling
description: Listens to the scrape of the ramrod in the bore to judge how much fouling has built up.

name: Sightswat
description: Wets a scrap of cloth in the mouth and runs it down the bore to soften the crust of burnt powder.

name: Ruthless Bolt
description: Strikes the ball home with the heel of the hand when the ramrod alone will not move it past the fouling.

name: Static Bipod
description: Shakes out a flashed pan, pours fresh powder and thumbs the cover down before the enemy can exploit the misfire.

name: Ember Squeeze
description: Keeps the muzzle on the enemy and the body motionless after a hangfire until the charge finally goes off.

name: Bolthasp
description: Shifts the leading hand to the wooden forestock and drops the rifle to a safe angle when the barrel runs too hot to hold.

name: Shower Zero
description: Sweeps qi down the bore beside the ramrod to burn clinging fouling clear between two shots.

name: Brawn Buttpad
description: Raps the butt on the ground to shake a stuck ball loose, then drives it home with a pulse of qi in the arm.

name: Zeroswerve
description: Dashes in a broken line, changing direction every third stride so no aimed shot can lead the runner.

name: Gleam Magazine
description: Pivots on the leading foot to square the hips to a new target and fires without moving the feet again.

name: Sighthurdle
description: Throws the body to the ground with a shoulder roll that carries the shooter out of an enemy's line.

name: Rill Cheekrest
description: Lands each step on the outer heel and rolls to the toe so that nothing cracks or scuffs on the approach.

name: Brawn Bolt
description: Drives the shoulder into an enemy's chest with the barrel pinned across both bodies, shoving him off his stance.

name: Lurching Chamber
description: Spins half round while backing away and fires over the shoulder at the pursuer closest behind.

name: Static Rifling
description: Bursts into a sprint on qi and stops dead within two strides, raising the rifle on the enemy who overran the position.

name: Brawnsight
description: Feeds qi to the legs so the torso stays level over a running gait and the sight does not bob.

name: Poise Muzzlebrake
description: Ducks beneath an enemy's thrust and rises inside it, sweeping the butt-plate up through his guard.

name: Breathflog
description: Rips the paper with the incisors and empties the powder into the muzzle in one clean tip of the wrist.

name: Rugged Scopemount
description: Presses the patched ball flush with the muzzle using the thumb alone, freeing the other hand for the ramrod.

name: Cruel Rearsight
description: Pulls the ramrod only as far as needed to clear the pipe, then thrusts it down the bore without a fumble.

name: Zeroslap
description: Taps the powder horn twice over the pan for a measured priming and snaps the cover shut.

name: Vicious Magazine
description: Runs qi through the arms to speed the seven drilled motions of loading until they seem a single flowing act.

name: Fleet Bipod
description: Loads while backing away in a gentle curve, qi steadying the hands as the feet find the ground by feel.
